home.title: Munaxa Work
home.lead: Enterprise HR administration. Every screen below reads the product API and shows what it returned.

record.title: Employee record
record.boundaries: What this record does not show
record.notFound: No employment with this identifier was returned.

notice.readOnly: This portal reads; it writes nothing. Every change is an API capability the server decides.
notice.sectionWithheld: This section was withheld: the API did not answer for this caller.
notice.eachSectionIsItsOwnPermission: Each section is a separate request under its own permission, so a section may be withheld while its neighbours are not.
notice.identifiersNotNames: Where a name belongs to another module and was not returned, a shortened identifier is shown rather than a name this screen invented.
notice.noDocumentContent: Document content is not stored by this product: there is no storage adapter, so nothing here can be opened or downloaded.
notice.notSignedIn: No principal is authenticated: this deployment has no Platform authentication adapter, so every read fails closed and every section is empty.
notice.noOffboarding: Offboarding, final settlement, loans and benefits are not built.
notice.noSelfService: This record is the administrator's view. Employee and manager self-service are not built.
notice.noPerformanceRead: Performance publishes no per-employment review read: the module holds that confirming a review exists for a named employment is itself a disclosure, so this record does not ask for one.
notice.noCompensationOnRecord: Salary and compensation are not on this record. Compensation publishes per-employment reads and putting them on the record everybody opens is a decision nobody has taken.
